method: Read all289 registry/scope/owning-stage/durable propositions, all32 full context profiles and7 exact caption occurrence sets. Every full payload is compared with immutable predecessor evidence; all3877 old occurrence bindings are reconstructed losslessly from the original queue pointer and ordered content-addressed transport references, then verified against pinned base/successor bytes. Structural metadata/ownership and fixed explanations are distinguished from current semantic domains and actual complete derivations. No referenced implementation/test/proof result was opened.

decisions.EXACT_STAGE_FIELD_AND_DURABLE_CONTEXT: The exact local stage/field/durable caption and immediate governed occurrence set remains. Its additional upstream registry/scope/ownership references remain supporting constraints, not content governed by the local heading. Each child is separately reconciled, including changed domains; no inserted clause is absorbed into an original range.
decisions.PRESERVED_REGISTRY_STRUCTURE: The individual closed-registry owner, metadata column, ordered default priority, static producer/identity/projection rule, undefined-contract blocker or independent omission-challenge/digest-pin method remains. A/B/E use existing ownership, D retains independent registry review and F1 preserves canonical writers. This does not accept an old complete registry, digest or derived value.
decisions.PRESERVED_COMMON_SCOPE: The exact common envelope dimensions, original Stage01–07 dimensions, three static scope classes, reservation-before-creation rule and current-input/reserved-target checks remain. A shares the existing envelope and grants no reverse authority; B authoring before review is not acceptance; F1/F2 waive no ordinary scope precondition. Current later-route domain changes separately.
decisions.PRESERVED_STAGE_ARCHITECTURE: The individual fixed stage association, actor, fixture design/creation/execution separation, accepted-invalid-fixture validator-defect relation, original Stage07 operation set, new candidate/iteration, identity/version reference, created-context namespace, identical-package equality or continued/withheld-context constraint remains. F1 preserves owning writers and Stage17 REGRESSION authority; F2 does not prove hidden separation.
decisions.PRESERVED_DURABLE_STRUCTURE: The individual durable object must remain an explicit family or registered closed typed nested object with exactly one named owner and never an untyped stage blob. The identity/owner/lifecycle/scope/relationships/invalidation/persistence schema remains. This records storage/authority structure without asserting unchanged values, semantics, approval or current object contents.
decisions.COMPLETE_FIELD_UNIVERSE: The complete current field/relationship/prompt/package/result/receipt/terminal universe and exactly-once coverage now includes applicable A–F2 contracts. Existing metadata columns and specification-controlled default priorities remain, but a complete old registry cannot stand in for the new closed universe. Missing inherited decoder/binding/XML details remain qualified and cannot be omitted or invented.
decisions.CLOSED_FIELD_DEFAULT_WRITE_DOMAIN: A/B/D/E close current nested fields, exact permissible defaults and normalized forms; F1 adds only conditional receipt/evidence writes while preserving owning writers. Unknown/default/write-set rejection must evaluate this current domain. No arbitrary extension, coercion, affected-field reverse write or unregistered operation is permitted.
decisions.CONDITIONAL_LATER_STAGE_SCOPE_DOMAIN: F1 adds exact conditional later-stage pairs, changing the stage-operation domain over which the current specific scope/echo/rejection rules apply. Every old named dimension, nullability and scope class remains. New pairs require accepted compatible definition/test/fixture/target/history context; missing specialized bindings remain qualified rather than guessed. F2 supplies input basis, not scope or writer authority.
decisions.EXACT_STAGE15_AND_STAGE17_OPERATION_SET: The exact Stage15 set adds only conditional EXECUTE_FAILURE_TEST; Stage17 adds only conditional EXECUTE_FAILURE_TEST and EXECUTE_REGRESSION. F1 preserves ordinary Stage15 writers and Stage17 REGRESSION permissions. Added routes remain receipt-only and require current accepted independently reviewed compatible binding/history/phase/target; no route name supplies missing semantics.
decisions.FAILURE_TEST_CURRENT_EXECUTABILITY_AND_T: Actual complete failure analysis, EXECUTABLE_NOW execution, valid future triggers and expected/actual rejection now use B reviewed target availability, D exact definitions/results and applicable F1/F2 binding/input context with A external admission. Future fixtures stay visible/unexecuted and execution must be real and isolated. The mere presence of a required-by stage is separately retained; applicable XML/binding limits remain explicit.
decisions.FAILURE_STAGE_DERIVED_FIELDS: These actual current Stage07 projections, coverage, defect, decision and evidence values depend on current admitted requirements/records, B target availability, D validator/results, E test context and A/F2 current review/input basis, with applicable F1 execution binding. This does not redefine requirement applicability or shrink ACTIVE_REQUIREMENTS: mandatory source membership remains. Field names and APPLICATION ownership do not establish current derived completeness.
decisions.REGRESSION_DEFINITION_AND_CURRENT_FAILUR: Actual current confirmed defects, regression/test projections, proof counts and completion depend on B availability, D outcomes, E current context and A/F2 accepted evidence with applicable F1 bindings. Every confirmed defect still requires a permanent definition and real pre-correction failure; owning Stage15 writers, preserved failure and retirement safeguards remain. No missing binding or XML meaning is invented.
decisions.DISTINCT_ACTUAL_POST_CORRECTION_INPUT: F1 makes explicit that post-correction success needs a distinct later execution with distinct actual target input identity and actual pre/post observations; F2 supplies exact route input basis. A relabeled identical input or single observation cannot prove both. Isolation, attribution, custody/restoration and conditional binding requirements persist.
decisions.REPEATED_ITERATION_COMPARISON: Actual complete ten-run comparison and its completion summary consume current accepted runs, B due results, D outcomes and E normalized frozen variance with A/F2 current admission. Fixed arithmetic, all-ten coverage and no omitted run remain; frozen bytes alone do not supply semantic approval.
decisions.REPEATED_ITERATION_VERIFICATION_AND_REGR: Actual complete verification/regression execution, added-regression and decision/evidence summaries use B due relation sets, D meanings, E current test context, A/F2 admission and F1 due compatible actual receipts. Future duties are preserved and not executed early. The literal visible-explanation atom is separately corrected; an unchanged evaluator name cannot establish current completeness.
decisions.REPEATED_ITERATION_CORRECTION_AND_RCA: Actual current complete correction/RCA behavior concerns the classified current failures and admissible semantic records. D changes failure/error meanings and A/F2 relevant response/input admission, while canonical semantic ownership, causal evidence, new-version discipline and independent review remain. This batch does not incorporate a new counting-unit interpretation for other fields.
decisions.TEN_CURRENT_ACCEPTED_RUNS: The source completion requires ten new current accepted runs; A/F2 changes their current external admission/input support in addition to original fresh-context, candidate, reservation, actual-execution and independence requirements. Failed attempts are historical and cannot count. No denominator or accepted-context count is reduced.
decisions.CLOSED_EXPECTED_VARIANCE_OBJECT: E changes normalized variance contents, current snapshot/test/scope/hash/lifecycle semantics and one-current-contract resolution. The candidate atom here is only the preexisting single-owner storage form, so it is corrected below; complete normalization/semantic duties remain separately changed.

Base2806 already constrains REQUIRED_BY_STAGE against target availability; F1 successor1195–1199 preserves timing and actual-execution conditions. B changes availability proof and the valid-trigger/executable predicate, not this presence-of-required-by metadata rule. Retain this atom while adjacent actual executability and valid-trigger atoms remain changed.

It does not itself compute due relation cells or establish execution/verification completeness. B/D/E/F1/F2 change actual current rerun duties at3394 and their derived completion fields, which remain changed.
